\section{Unknown command}
This paragraph invokes \totallyMadeUpCommand{with an arg} that no preamble defines.
And a starred sibling \alsoUnknown*[opt]{arg} for good measure.

\section{Unknown environment}

Some content inside an environment the parser does not know.
\end{frobinator}

\section{Recoverable text}
Stray close brace } in running text, plus \emph{partial italics with no closer.
